answer_1.quote: One specific domain within dialogs where LLMs show promise is in building Task-Oriented Dialogs (TOD) systems, where they generate agent responses based on the dialog history and taskspecific knowledge.

answer_2.quote: For evaluating model performance, we use the Entity F1 and BLEU metrics prevalent in the end-to-end TOD paradigm.

answer_4.quote: We had two annotators evaluate responses from Gold, MAKER, and SyncTOD (GPT-4) models.
answer_4.guideline: They assessed the responses for a) appropriateness to the dialog history and KB, b) fluency and c) consistency on a 1-5 Likert Scale.
